blocks.text: Who to play Mark Zuckerberg is one of the most important decisions made in creating The Social Reckoning. With this, writer-director Aaron Sorkin chose to collaborate once more with Jeremy Strong. They’ve worked together on Molly’s Game and The Trial of the Chicago 7, and Jeremy Strong has since then received accolades such as Golden Globe and Emmy wins for his role as Kendall Roy in Succession, and an Oscar nomination for his portrayal of Roy Cohn in The Apprentice. Strong is now taking on another real-life character in The Social Reckoning, which explores the insidious power algorithms in social media, […]...
